## Components · Action

### Button

`import { Button } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Button`

Runs one action from a text label; the primary way to commit, cancel or start something.

- Use for: Commit or cancel a form or dialog
- Use for: Start an action from a page or section header
- Use for: Offer a secondary action next to a primary one
- Not for: The action is an icon without a visible label → `IconButton`
- Not for: A whole row or card should be clickable → `Clickable`
- Not for: A primary action with related alternatives → `SplitButton`
- Not for: A rounded chip in the composer toolbar → `PillButton`
- Tokens: `--control-height-md`, `--radius-control`, `--send-bg`, `--focus-ring`, `--motion-scale-press`

### ButtonContainer

`import { ButtonContainer } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/ButtonContainer`

Lays out two or more adjacent buttons with the gap that matches their size.

- Use for: Place several buttons next to each other
- Use for: Align a group of actions to the end of a footer
- Not for: A single button → `Button`
- Not for: Icon actions trailing a list row → `ListRow`
- Not for: General row layout of mixed content → `Stack`
- Tokens: `--space-sm`, `--space-xs`

### Clickable

`import { Clickable } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Clickable`

Makes a row, tile or piece of text one keyboard-operable click target without a button's look.

- Use for: Make a whole list row clickable
- Use for: Turn a title into a quiet text link that opens details
- Not for: A labelled action → `Button`
- Not for: A sidebar navigation row → `NavRow`
- Not for: A card that opens something → `Card`
- Tokens: `--selection`, `--radius-control`, `--focus-ring`, `--interactive-disabled-fg`

### CopyButton

`import { CopyButton } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/CopyButton`

Copies text to the clipboard and confirms with an icon morph and a live announcement.

- Use for: Copy a message, code block or identifier
- Use for: Offer a copy action in a footer or code frame header
- Not for: Any other icon-only action → `IconButton`
- Not for: Copy a design token name in the viewer → `Button`
- Tokens: `--motion-fast`, `--motion-scale-menu`, `--color-success`

### GlyphToggle

`import { GlyphToggle } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/GlyphToggle`

A row glyph that doubles as a pin toggle: the glyph keeps its column, the toggle glyph shows on hover and focus.

- Use for: Pin or favorite a sidebar row without adding a trailing action
- Not for: A standalone icon action → `IconButton`
- Not for: A static glyph → `IconSlot`
- Tokens: `--sidebar-icon-size`, `--control-hit-target`

### IconButton

`import { IconButton } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/IconButton`

An icon-only action with a required label that doubles as its tooltip.

- Use for: An action whose icon is universally understood (close, back, panel toggles)
- Use for: Compact row or toolbar actions
- Not for: The action needs words to be understood → `Button`
- Not for: Copying text with confirmation → `CopyButton`
- Not for: A rounded chip with an icon and text → `PillButton`
- Tokens: `--control-height-md`, `--selection`, `--radius-pill`, `--focus-ring`, `--control-hit-target`, `--butler-ink-blue`, `--butler-ink-pink`

### PillButton

`import { PillButton } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/PillButton`

A rounded borderless chip for compact, frequent actions around the composer.

- Use for: A capsule above the composer (progress, report)
- Use for: A chip-like action with an icon and a short label
- Not for: A form or dialog action → `Button`
- Not for: A composer toolbar control with label and detail → `ComposerControl`
- Not for: A status label that is not clickable → `Tag`
- Tokens: `--radius-pill`, `--tinted-glass-bg`, `--control-height-sm`

## Components · Input

### ColorSwatchInput

`import { ColorSwatchInput } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/ColorSwatchInput`

A round swatch that opens the system color picker for one color value.

- Use for: Let people pick a theme or fluid-background color
- Not for: Typing a hex value precisely → `Input`
- Not for: Choosing among a few named colors → `SegmentedControl`
- Tokens: `--radius-pill`, `--line`, `--focus-ring`

### Field

`import { Field } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Field`

Groups a label, a control, help and errors so forms keep one vertical rhythm.

- Use for: A form field inside a dialog or an editor form
- Use for: Group several fields with FieldSet and FieldGroup
- Not for: A settings row with label, description and trailing control → `SettingsField`
- Not for: A lone control that only needs a name → `Label`
- Tokens: `--space-sm`, `--space-xs`, `--text-secondary`, `--danger`

### Input

`import { Input } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Input`

A single-line field for names, IDs, URLs, numbers and secrets. Use variant=default for a box, variant=underline for in-place entry, and compact for a short toolbar field.

- Use for: Enter a short value such as a name, ID or URL
- Use for: Show a masked or read-only value that people can select
- Not for: Several lines of text → `Textarea`
- Not for: Choosing from a fixed list → `Select`
- Not for: A token budget with a slider → `TokenInputControl`
- Not for: A percentage with a slider → `PercentInputControl`
- Tokens: `--line-strong`, `--border-hairline`, `--focus-ring-width`, `--focus-ring-color`, `--line`, `--radius-control`, `--placeholder`, `--focus-ring`, `--color-disabled-bg`, `--color-danger-border`

### Label

`import { Label } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Label`

Names one form control and makes its text a click target for it.

- Use for: Name a lone control outside a Field
- Not for: A label inside a form field → `FieldLabel`
- Not for: A settings row → `SettingsField`
- Tokens: `--typo-label-size`, `--font-weight-medium`

### NativeSelect

`import { NativeSelect } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/NativeSelect`

A styled native <select>: the platform picker, with the Butler trigger look.

- Use for: Pick one value in a dense form or a secret row
- Use for: Mobile-friendly choice where the OS picker is best
- Not for: Options need icons, descriptions or custom rendering → `Select`
- Not for: Searching a long list → `FilteredSelectPopover`
- Not for: Two to four visible choices → `SegmentedControl`
- Tokens: `--control-height-md`, `--radius-control`, `--line`, `--focus-ring`

### SegmentedControl

`import { SegmentedControl } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/SegmentedControl`

A compact single-choice radiogroup that changes what one panel shows.

- Use for: Switch a chart period or dataset
- Use for: Pick a mode among two to five short options
- Not for: Switching between panels of content → `Tabs`
- Not for: More than five options or long labels → `Select`
- Not for: An on/off setting → `Switch`
- Tokens: `--selection`, `--radius-control`, `--motion-fast`, `--control-height-sm`

### Select

`import { Select } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Select`

A Radix select with the Butler trigger and menu, for one value from a list.

- Use for: Choose one value with grouped or rich options
- Use for: A glass pill select in the composer
- Not for: Plain options in a dense form or on phones → `NativeSelect`
- Not for: A searchable list with filters → `FilteredSelectPopover`
- Not for: A trigger that opens a custom popover → `SelectButton`
- Tokens: `--control-height-md`, `--menu-item-height`, `--radius-popover`, `--motion-enter-menu`, `--motion-scale-menu`, `--icon-size-md`

### Slider

`import { Slider } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Slider`

A controlled range input for choosing a number between bounds by feel.

- Use for: Adjust a budget or threshold where the rough position matters more than the exact digit
- Not for: An exact number must be typed → `Input`
- Not for: A percentage with both slider and input → `PercentInputControl`
- Tokens: `--accent`, `--selection`, `--focus-ring`

### Switch

`import { Switch } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Switch`

An on/off setting that takes effect immediately.

- Use for: Turn a setting on or off without a save step
- Not for: Choosing among several modes → `SegmentedControl`
- Not for: An action that runs once → `Button`
- Tokens: `--switch-track-bg`, `--switch-thumb`, `--accent`, `--motion-ease-spring`, `--motion-base`

### Textarea

`import { Textarea } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Textarea`

A multi-line text box for prompts, personas, arguments and descriptions.

- Use for: Enter a paragraph or a list with one item per line
- Use for: In-place wrapping entry: variant=underline, textSize=label beside Typo.Label
- Not for: A single-line value → `Input`
- Not for: Writing a chat message → `ComposerCard`
- Tokens: `--line`, `--radius-control`, `--placeholder`, `--focus-ring`, `--focus-ring-width`, `--textarea-max-lines`, `--scroll-fade-size`

## Components · Overlay

### ContextMenu

`import { ContextMenu } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/ContextMenu`

Secondary actions on right-click or long-press of a piece of content.

- Use for: Offer copy or branch actions on messages without a visible button
- Not for: The only way to reach an action → `DropdownMenu`
- Not for: A visible row menu → `OverflowActionMenu`
- Tokens: `--menu-item-height`, `--radius-popover`, `--motion-enter-menu`, `--z-popover`

### Dialog

`import { Dialog } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Dialog`

A modal glass surface for a focused task that must finish or be dismissed before going on.

- Use for: Rename, create or confirm something destructive
- Use for: Read a document on top of the current screen
- Not for: A small choice anchored to a control → `Popover`
- Not for: A list of actions for an item → `DropdownMenu`
- Not for: Global search and commands → `CommandPalettePanel`
- Not for: A notification that needs no decision → `Toaster`
- Tokens: `--dialog-overlay-bg`, `--tinted-glass-bg`, `--z-dialog`, `--motion-fast`, `--motion-scale-dialog`

### DropdownMenu

`import { DropdownMenu } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/DropdownMenu`

A menu of actions (and radio or checkbox choices) anchored to a trigger.

- Use for: Several actions for one item behind a More button
- Use for: A view menu with radio and checkbox items
- Not for: A row's overflow menu with icon items → `OverflowActionMenu`
- Not for: Right-click actions on content → `ContextMenu`
- Not for: Picking a value for a form → `Select`
- Not for: A composer chooser with descriptions → `OptionMenu`
- Tokens: `--menu-item-height`, `--radius-popover`, `--motion-enter-menu`, `--motion-ease-enter`, `--motion-exit-menu`, `--motion-scale-menu`, `--z-popover`

### Popover

`import { Popover } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Popover`

A non-modal glass layer anchored to a control, for choosers and small panels.

- Use for: A chooser opened from a composer control
- Use for: A searchable select (with FilteredSelectPopover)
- Not for: A plain list of actions → `DropdownMenu`
- Not for: A task that needs focus and a backdrop → `Dialog`
- Not for: A label that explains a control → `Tooltip`
- Tokens: `--tinted-glass-bg`, `--radius-popover`, `--motion-enter-overlay`, `--motion-scale-menu`, `--z-popover`

### Tooltip

`import { Tooltip } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Tooltip`

A short glass label shown after a hover delay or on keyboard focus.

- Use for: Name an icon-only control (IconButton does it for you)
- Use for: Explain why a control is unavailable
- Not for: Content people must read or act on → `Popover`
- Not for: Inline help under a field → `FieldDescription`
- Not for: An icon-only button → `IconButton`
- Tokens: `--tinted-glass-bg`, `--radius-control`, `--motion-enter-menu`, `--z-tooltip`

## Components · Navigation

### Breadcrumb

`import { Breadcrumb } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Breadcrumb`

Shows where a nested page sits and lets people step back up the hierarchy.

- Use for: A page two or more levels deep (settings detail, automation detail)
- Not for: Switching sibling views → `Tabs`
- Not for: A single back step → `IconButton`
- Tokens: `--text-secondary`, `--text-primary`, `--icon-size-sm`

### Tabs

`import { Tabs } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Tabs`

Switches between sibling panels of content in the same place.

- Use for: Inspector sections (Summary, Files, Workers)
- Use for: Page sections with the line variant
- Not for: Filtering or changing what one panel shows → `SegmentedControl`
- Not for: Navigating to another page → `NavRow`
- Tokens: `--selection`, `--radius-control`, `--tabs-line-indicator-gap`, `--motion-fast`

## Components · Layout

### AspectFrame

`import { AspectFrame } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/AspectFrame`

A square, paint-contained frame that sizes a canvas or media element.

- Use for: A canvas animation or media that must stay square (the thinking mark)
- Not for: An icon glyph → `IconSlot`
- Not for: A document or image preview → `ArtifactPreview`
- Tokens: `--icon-size-sm`, `--icon-size-2xl`

### Box

`import { Box } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Box`

One surface: padding, radius, background and border from tokens, with no tone or behavior.

- Use for: Inset content by a token step
- Use for: Give a region a muted or raised surface with a hairline
- Not for: A card that can be selected or clicked → `Card`
- Not for: A floating translucent surface → `TintedGlass`
- Not for: A settings or inspector panel → `SurfacePanel`
- Tokens: `--space-sm`, `--radius-panel`, `--surface-raised`, `--color-surface-raised-opaque`, `--shadow-card`, `--line`

### Card

`import { Card } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Card`

A raised container for one item in a grid of items, optionally interactive and selectable.

- Use for: An item in a dashboard grid
- Use for: A suggestion or briefing entry with its own action
- Use for: A running task in a task graph (activity="running")
- Not for: Only padding or a background → `Box`
- Not for: A document or artifact tile with actions → `DocumentTile`
- Not for: A row in a list → `ListRow`
- Tokens: `--surface-raised`, `--radius-panel`, `--shadow-card`, `--selection`, `--focus-ring`, `--worker-active`, `--pulse-duration`, `--motion-loop-count`

### Collapsible

`import { Collapsible } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Collapsible`

Reveals and folds content with a height and opacity transition that respects reduced motion.

- Use for: Expand details under a row or tool call
- Use for: Animate rows entering and leaving a list
- Not for: A sidebar folder → `CollapsibleNavGroup`
- Not for: A disclosure row with a title and chevron → `DisclosureRow`
- Not for: Mount and unmount with a fade only → `Presence`
- Tokens: `--motion-base`, `--motion-exit-base`, `--motion-ease-standard`

### Grid

`import { Grid } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Grid`

Two-dimensional layout with column presets, responsive columns and item spans.

- Use for: A grid of cards or tiles that reflows by width
- Use for: Main and aside columns on a page
- Not for: A single row or column → `Stack`
- Not for: Metric cards → `MetricGrid`
- Tokens: `--space-md`, `--layout-basis-sm`, `--page-max-width-wide`

### Inline

`import { Inline } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Inline`

A wrapping row for chips, tags and icon-plus-text metadata, centered on one line.

- Use for: A row of tags or chips that may wrap
- Use for: An icon next to a caption
- Not for: Rows that should not wrap, or need grow/truncate → `Stack`
- Not for: Adjacent buttons → `ButtonContainer`
- Tokens: `--space-sm`, `--space-xs`

### Layout

`import { Layout } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Layout`

Layout item props (grow, shrink, basis, minWidth, alignSelf, span, invisible) that place children of Stack and Grid.

- Use for: Let one child take the free space
- Use for: Keep a trailing item from shrinking
- Use for: Reserve space for a hidden item
- Not for: Padding or a surface → `Box`
- Not for: Spacing between siblings → `Stack`
- Tokens: `--layout-basis-xs`, `--layout-basis-sm`, `--layout-basis-md`, `--layout-basis-lg`

### PageContainer

`import { PageContainer } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/PageContainer`

Caps a page's width (narrow, default, full) with the adaptive gutter and optional start alignment.

- Use for: The outer frame of a settings, dashboard or document page
- Not for: Spacing inside a page → `Stack`
- Not for: A padded surface → `Box`
- Tokens: `--page-max-width-reading`, `--page-max-width-wide`, `--page-container-gutter`

### Section

`import { Section } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Section`

A titled region: title (with optional icon and actions), description and content with a token gap.

- Use for: A titled group inside an inspector or dashboard panel
- Use for: A page region with its own heading level
- Not for: A settings section whose header sits above a card → `FormSection`
- Not for: A panel with a surface and header → `InspectorPanel`
- Not for: A sidebar group → `NavSection`
- Tokens: `--typo-panel-section-title-size`, `--space-md`, `--space-lg`

### Separator

`import { Separator } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Separator`

A hairline (or spacing-only) divider, horizontal or vertical, with a token space around it.

- Use for: Separate rows of a list that is not a card list
- Use for: Divide inline items vertically
- Not for: Only vertical space is needed → `Space`
- Not for: A list of cards → `CardList`
- Tokens: `--line`, `--line-strong`, `--space-md`

### Space

`import { Space } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Space`

An empty token-sized spacer where siblings do not live in a Stack.

- Use for: Add one gap between siblings that are not in a Stack (message body and its attachments)
- Not for: Regular spacing between siblings → `Stack`
- Not for: A visible divider → `Separator`
- Tokens: `--space-md`, `--space-lg`

### Stack

`import { Stack } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Stack`

One-dimensional layout (column or row) with token gaps and item props instead of CSS.

- Use for: Stack content vertically with a named gap
- Use for: Lay out a row that grows, wraps or truncates
- Not for: Two-dimensional layouts with columns → `Grid`
- Not for: A wrapping row of chips or metadata → `Inline`
- Not for: Adjacent buttons → `ButtonContainer`
- Not for: Padding, surface or border around content → `Box`
- Tokens: `--space-xs`, `--space-sm`, `--space-md`, `--space-lg`, `--layout-basis-md`

### TintedGlass

`import { TintedGlass } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/TintedGlass`

The translucent, tinted surface for floating layers over the conversation.

- Use for: A custom floating layer that is not already a DS overlay
- Not for: A menu, popover, dialog or tooltip → `Popover`
- Not for: An opaque card or panel on the page → `Box`
- Not for: The message composer → `ComposerCard`
- Tokens: `--tinted-glass-bg`, `--tinted-glass-tint`, `--tinted-glass-filter`, `--tinted-glass-shadow`, `--tinted-glass-edge-size`

## Components · Feedback

### ButlerThinkingMark

`import { ButlerThinkingMark } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/ButlerThinkingMark`

Butler's identity mark and its thinking animation: the filled logo at rest, a riso halftone moon while Butler works.

- Use for: Butler itself is thinking or working (assistant status label, active work capsules)
- Use for: The Butler identity next to an assistant turn, idle once the turn is done
- Not for: Generic indeterminate loading of data or a control → `Spinner`
- Not for: A task row or step whose success replaces the loader → `LoadingIndicator`
- Not for: Confirming that an action finished → `SuccessCheck`
- Not for: Layout placeholders while content loads → `Skeleton`
- Tokens: `--pulse-duration`, `--spinner-easing`, `--motion-slow`, `--motion-ease-standard`, `--icon-size-sm`, `--icon-size-xl`

### LoadingIndicator

`import { LoadingIndicator } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/LoadingIndicator`

One icon slot that shows the Spinner while work runs and draws the ringed SuccessCheck when it completes.

- Use for: A running row, step or task whose success replaces the spinner
- Use for: A busy control that confirms completion in place
- Not for: Work that can also fail or be cancelled with no success → `Spinner`
- Not for: A plain completion mark without a loading phase → `SuccessCheck`
- Tokens: `--spinner-duration`, `--motion-slow`, `--motion-scale-check`

### Presence

`import { Presence } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Presence`

Keeps a child mounted through its exit animation and exposes data-state open/closed.

- Use for: Mount and unmount a small element with a fade or rise
- Use for: Build a DS component that needs an exit animation
- Not for: Revealing content with a height change → `Collapsible`
- Not for: Swapping one line of status text → `RollingSwap`
- Tokens: `--motion-base`, `--motion-exit-base`, `--motion-distance-sm`

### ProgressRing

`import { ProgressRing } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/ProgressRing`

A non-interactive ring that shows progress, known or not, in an icon-sized square.

- Use for: Progress in an icon slot (a sidebar row, a status line)
- Use for: A download or update whose size may not be known yet
- Not for: A labelled progress bar with room for its own row → `ProgressMeter`
- Not for: Context usage that opens details on click → `ContextDonutButton`
- Not for: Busy with no progress to report, next to a verb → `Spinner`
- Not for: Loading that ends in a success check in the same slot → `LoadingIndicator`
- Tokens: `--context-track-bg`, `--accent`, `--color-success`, `--color-danger`, `--icon-size-md`, `--sidebar-icon-size`, `--motion-fast`, `--spinner-duration`

### RollingStatusLine

`import { RollingStatusLine } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/RollingStatusLine`

A one-line live status that truncates long text and keeps its height stable.

- Use for: Show what the assistant is doing right now in one line
- Not for: Replacing the status with an animated swap → `RollingSwap`
- Not for: A list of finished steps → `ActivityFeed`
- Tokens: `--typo-body-size`, `--line-height-body`

### RollingSwap

`import { RollingSwap } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/RollingSwap`

Rolls one short piece of content out and the next one in when its key changes.

- Use for: A status or step label that changes while work runs
- Not for: Counting numbers → `AnimatedNumber`
- Not for: Showing and hiding content → `Presence`
- Tokens: `--motion-base`, `--motion-distance-sm`, `--motion-ease-decelerate`

### Skeleton

`import { Skeleton } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Skeleton`

A shimmering placeholder in the shape of content that is still loading.

- Use for: The layout of the coming content is known (rows, lines, cards)
- Not for: Loading has no known shape or is inside a control → `Spinner`
- Not for: Loading failed → `Notice`
- Tokens: `--surface-raised`, `--shimmer-duration`, `--radius-control`

### Spinner

`import { Spinner } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Spinner`

Butler's indeterminate traveling-gap indicator, sized to the icon scale.

- Use for: Something is running with no known duration
- Use for: Replace an icon while its row is busy
- Not for: The shape of loading content is known → `Skeleton`
- Not for: Progress with a known fraction → `ProgressMeter`
- Not for: Progress in an icon slot that may become known → `ProgressRing`
- Not for: Success replaces the spinner in the same slot → `LoadingIndicator`
- Tokens: `--spinner-duration`, `--spinner-rotate-duration`, `--spinner-easing`, `--icon-size-sm`

### SuccessCheck

`import { SuccessCheck } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/SuccessCheck`

The DS completion mark: a check (optionally in a ring) whose stroke draws in with a subtle pop.

- Use for: Confirm that an action just finished, in the icon slot where it ran
- Use for: The done state after a Spinner (use LoadingIndicator)
- Not for: A spinner that resolves into done → `LoadingIndicator`
- Not for: A static done status in a list of history → `Icons`
- Not for: A confirmation with no on-screen place → `Toast`
- Tokens: `--motion-slow`, `--motion-base`, `--motion-menu`, `--motion-ease-standard`, `--motion-scale-check`

### Toast

`import { Toast } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Toast`

Transient confirmations and errors at the top center that dismiss themselves (sonner, DS-styled).

- Use for: Confirm an action that has no visible result on screen
- Use for: Report a background failure with an optional retry or undo
- Not for: An error tied to one place on the page → `Notice`
- Not for: A decision people must make → `Dialog`
- Tokens: `--popover`, `--shadow-card`, `--radius-panel`, `--motion-base`, `--motion-distance-lg`

## Components · Data display

### AnimatedNumber

`import { AnimatedNumber } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/AnimatedNumber`

Counts from the shown value to a new one over --motion-deliberate with tabular digits.

- Use for: A number that changes while people watch (counts, totals)
- Not for: A metric tile → `MetricCard`
- Not for: A static number → `Typo.Text`
- Tokens: `--motion-deliberate`, `--motion-ease-decelerate`, `--motion-fast`

### Chart

`import { Chart } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Chart`

Recharts wrapped with DS colors, tooltip and legend so series and legend never drift.

- Use for: Show a trend or distribution in a dashboard or statistics panel
- Not for: A single number → `MetricCard`
- Not for: Activity per day on a calendar → `ActivityHeatmap`
- Not for: A fraction of one budget → `ProgressMeter`
- Tokens: `--context-chart-1`, `--context-chart-2`, `--color-success`, `--color-danger`, `--line`

### FoundationHeroMotion

`import { FoundationHeroMotion } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/FoundationHeroMotion`

The looping motion graphic at the head of a Foundations chapter, drawn from that foundation's live tokens.

- Use for: The header of a Foundations chapter in the DS Viewer (one hero per chapter)
- Not for: Showing that something is loading or working → `Spinner`
- Not for: Butler itself is thinking → `ButlerThinkingMark`
- Not for: A small chapter thumbnail in a card grid → `Card`
- Tokens: `--motion-deliberate`, `--motion-ease-standard`, `--motion-ease-emphasized`, `--motion-ease-spring`, `--motion-distance-md`, `--space-xs`, `--space-4xl`, `--control-height-xs`, `--control-height-lg`, `--icon-size-xs`, `--icon-size-2xl`, `--radius-control`, `--radius-composer`, `--shadow-card`, `--shadow-window`, `--focus-ring`

### IconSlot

`import { IconSlot } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/IconSlot`

A fixed square that centers one glyph so rows, status marks and markers line up.

- Use for: A glyph that must keep its column width (row glyphs, status marks, timeline markers)
- Not for: A clickable icon → `IconButton`
- Not for: An icon that swaps to a toggle on hover → `GlyphToggle`
- Tokens: `--icon-size-md`, `--sidebar-icon-size`

### IconTile

`import { IconTile } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/IconTile`

A rounded square that holds one glyph: a service logo, a point in a list, or the state of a setup screen.

- Use for: A logo or icon that needs a quiet square behind it
- Use for: The state glyph of a setup or sign-in screen
- Not for: A glyph in a row that only needs its column width → `IconSlot`
- Not for: A clickable icon → `IconButton`
- Tokens: `--muted`, `--line`, `--color-info-bg`, `--color-info-text`, `--danger`, `--radius-control`, `--radius-popover`

### Icons

`import { Icons } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Icons`

The Hugeicons free set from hugeicons.com (MIT), mapped to Butler names and sized by the icon token scale.

- Use for: Support a label with a glyph
- Use for: Mark row types in lists and navigation
- Not for: An icon that is the whole control → `IconButton`
- Not for: A status word that needs color → `Tag`
- Tokens: `--icon-size-sm`, `--icon-size-md`, `--icon-size-lg`

### InlineReference

`import { InlineReference } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/InlineReference`

A mention inside running text: a conversation or document (opens in the app) or an external URL (opens in the browser), with its icon.

- Use for: Mention a conversation or document inside a message or summary
- Use for: An external http(s) link in a sentence, a reply, a caption or a settings description (kind="external")
- Use for: A standalone link that leaves the app, such as "Get a key" or "Learn more" (kind="external" inside Typo)
- Not for: An in-app action styled as a link (retry, copy link, show more) → `Button`
- Not for: A call to action that leaves the app (Install Git in a notice) → `Button`
- Not for: A URL the user reads or copies (server address, endpoint) → `Typo`
- Not for: Markdown output → `MarkdownContent`
- Not for: A document in a list → `DocumentTile`
- Tokens: `--accent-text`, `--text-primary`, `--selection`, `--icon-size-sm`, `--favicon-plate`, `--favicon-plate-line`, `--focus-ring-color`, `--motion-fast`

### Kbd

`import { Kbd } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Kbd`

Key caps for a keyboard shortcut, one <kbd> per key inside a combination.

- Use for: Teach a shortcut next to the control or in a hint
- Not for: The shortcut column of a menu item → `DropdownMenuShortcut`
- Not for: Code or a command name → `Typo.Code`
- Tokens: `--control-height-xs`, `--line-strong`, `--radius-control`, `--typo-caption-size`

### MetaList

`import { MetaList } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/MetaList`

A compact inline run of label/value facts separated by dots, as a description list.

- Use for: Two to five short facts under a title (usage, plan, source)
- Not for: Facts that need their own rows → `KeyValueRow`
- Not for: A single caption → `Typo.Caption`
- Tokens: `--text-secondary`, `--typo-caption-size`, `--space-xs`

### ProviderLogo

`import { ProviderLogo } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/ProviderLogo`

The logo of an AI service or local model server, drawn from vendored SVG files exactly as shipped.

- Use for: A service logo on a choice card, model row or connection list
- Not for: A generic action or status glyph → `Icons`
- Not for: A glyph that must keep its column width in a row → `IconSlot`
- Tokens: `--icon-size-sm`, `--icon-size-md`, `--icon-size-lg`, `--text-primary`

### Tag

`import { Tag } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Tag`

A small pill for a status, category or removable filter value.

- Use for: Show a status or category next to a title
- Use for: A removable filter chip
- Not for: A clickable action → `PillButton`
- Not for: An inline error or result message → `Notice`
- Tokens: `--radius-pill`, `--tag-height-sm`, `--tag-padding-inline-sm`, `--tag-padding-inline-md`, `--color-success-bg`, `--color-warning-bg`, `--color-danger-bg`, `--line`

### Typo

`import { Typo } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=components/Typo`

Every piece of text: document roles (H1–H6, Body, Caption, Label, Code) and compact app roles, all token-backed.

- Use for: Any visible text in product UI
- Use for: Tone, weight, truncation and line clamps without CSS
- Not for: A labelled form control → `FieldLabel`
- Not for: Rendered markdown → `MarkdownContent`
- Not for: A chat message body → `MessageRow`
- Tokens: `--typo-body-size`, `--typo-caption-size`, `--typo-panel-title-size`, `--font-weight-regular`, `--font-weight-strong`

## Blocks · Shell

### AdaptiveShell

`import { AdaptiveShell } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/AdaptiveShell`

The app frame: sidebar, workspace and inspector that become drawers over a scrim on compact widths.

- Not for: A page inside the workspace → `PageContainer`
- Not for: A static preview of the chrome → `ChromeFrame`
- Tokens: `--adaptive-drawer-width`, `--adaptive-inspector-width`, `--adaptive-panel-duration`, `--adaptive-scrim-bg`, `--sidebar-width`, `--browser-chat-width`, `--browser-chat-width-min`, `--browser-chat-width-max`, `--shell-bg`, `--shell-card-bg`, `--shell-card-inset`, `--shell-card-gap`, `--shell-card-radius`, `--shell-card-edge`, `--shell-card-shadow`

### ChromeFrame

`import { ChromeFrame } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/ChromeFrame`

The window chrome regions (sidebar, titlebar, main, inspector) with single-hairline joins and the floating toggle layer.

- Not for: The responsive app layout with drawers → `AdaptiveShell`
- Not for: The titlebar content itself → `TitlebarShell`

### ManagementPage

`import { ManagementPage } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/ManagementPage`

A scrolling management page (automations, project dashboard) with page width, gutters and an optional footer.

- Not for: Only a width cap → `PageContainer`
- Not for: A wallpaper behind the new-chat prompt → `PromptSuggestionList`

### NativeViewSlot

Reserves the rectangle a native Electron WebContentsView is laid over, reports its bounds and tells the App when DS overlays or moving panels cover it.

- Not for: Showing a captured page or artifact image → `ArtifactPreview`
- Not for: Rendering web content inside the DOM → `DocumentReader`

### PanelHeader

`import { PanelHeader } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/PanelHeader`

The header of a side panel: compact title, one-line description and trailing actions.

- Not for: A settings page title → `SettingsHeader`
- Not for: A titled group inside a panel → `Section`
- Tokens: `--typo-panel-title-size`, `--text-secondary`, `--space-sm`

### ScrollArea

`import { ScrollArea } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/ScrollArea`

A scroll container with the shared edge fades and thin scrollbars on its scrolling axis.

### SetupWizardShell

`import { SetupWizardShell } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/SetupWizardShell`

The first-run setup frame: step progress, a large title and centered content, or one focused column (variant focus).

- Use for: A multi-step setup or onboarding flow outside the app shell
- Use for: A short onboarding of one or two screens with no stepper
- Not for: A settings page → `SettingsShell`
- Not for: A short task in the app → `DialogForm`
- Tokens: `--titlebar-height`, `--motion-base`, `--motion-exit-base`, `--motion-distance-sm`, `--typo-new-chat-title-size-md`, `--page-max-width-narrow`, `--space-2xl`, `--space-lg`, `--color-surface-raised-opaque`

### SetupWizardStepCard

`import { SetupWizardStepCard } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/SetupWizardStepCard`

One step of a focus-variant setup flow: header (back · steps), a title with a bare 20px glyph, the step's content and a footer with right-aligned large actions.

- Use for: Every step after the intro in a first-run or setup flow
- Use for: A sub-step (sign-in, API key, model pick) that keeps the flow's header and footer
- Not for: The intro or welcome screen of a flow → `SetupWizardContent`
- Not for: A short task inside the app → `DialogForm`
- Not for: A settings page → `SettingsShell`
- Tokens: `--typo-h4-size`, `--typo-h4-line-height`, `--icon-size-lg`, `--control-height-lg`, `--space-lg`, `--motion-base`, `--motion-ease-decelerate`

### SidebarShell

`import { SidebarShell } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/SidebarShell`

The sidebar frame: titlebar space, fixed navigation, a scrolling list with fades, a footer and a density.

- Use for: The app sidebar and other sidebar-like navigation columns
- Not for: Settings navigation lists → `SettingsNav`
- Not for: A scrolling region in content → `ScrollArea`
- Tokens: `--sidebar-bg`, `--sidebar-width`, `--sidebar-row-height`, `--scroll-fade-size`, `--sidebar-padding-inline`

### SurfacePanel

`import { SurfacePanel } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/SurfacePanel`

A bordered panel surface with an elevation step for settings rows and grouped content.

- Use for: A flat bordered row or group inside settings and developer panels
- Not for: A clickable item in a grid → `Card`
- Not for: A settings section with a header above → `FormSection`
- Tokens: `--surface-raised`, `--line`, `--radius-panel`, `--shadow-card`

### TitlebarShell

`import { TitlebarShell } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/TitlebarShell`

The window titlebar: leading toggle, title and subtitle, trailing actions and window controls, draggable.

- Use for: The top bar of the app window
- Not for: A panel header → `PanelHeader`
- Not for: A page title → `DashboardHeader`
- Tokens: `--titlebar-height`, `--titlebar-bg`, `--chrome-floating-toggle-size`

### Wallpaper

`import { Wallpaper } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/Wallpaper`

The app wallpaper: a live WebGL2 shader module (built-in bloom and silk, or a user module), an image, or nothing, drawn behind a surface under one performance and motion policy.

- Use for: Behind a whole screen (new chat, setup wizard) with the default viewport scope
- Use for: Behind a content area such as a dashboard with scope="container"
- Use for: Whenever the background comes from settings or an agent as a WallpaperSource
- Use for: Art on a card (a decoration module such as butler.cherry-blossom): its transparent canvas leaves the glass visible
- Not for: A translucent surface over the wallpaper → `TintedGlass`
- Not for: Letting the user choose a wallpaper → `WallpaperPicker`
- Not for: The new-chat prompt screen (pass its wallpaper prop instead) → `PromptSuggestionList`
- Tokens: `--adaptive-viewport-block-size`, `--radius-panel`

### WallpaperStage

`import { WallpaperStage } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/WallpaperStage`

Center content above a Wallpaper on the viewport's base surface.

- Use for: A small desktop lifecycle viewport
- Not for: A first-run wizard → `SetupWizardShell`
- Tokens: `--space-lg`, `--z-content`

## Blocks · Browser

### AddressField

`import { AddressField } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/AddressField`

The browser toolbar's address: security glyph, bold host with a muted path, tags and the star; a click edits the full URL.

- Use for: The address in BrowserToolbar
- Use for: A Butler page's name in the same place (library, new tab)
- Not for: A plain URL setting in a form → `Input`
- Not for: A link inside text → `InlineReference`
- Tokens: `--control-height-md`, `--selection`, `--focus-ring`, `--radius-control`, `--placeholder`

### AgentPointer

`import { AgentPointer } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/AgentPointer`

Butler's own pointer for the transparent overlay layer above a page: where Butler looks, clicks, types or scrolls, never mistaken for yours.

- Use for: The overlay renderer while Butler acts on a tab
- Use for: Showing that Butler waits (parked) while you hold the tab or an approval waits
- Not for: Saying what Butler is doing in words → `PageBand`
- Not for: A pick highlight the user made → `SelectionBar`
- Tokens: `--motion-pointer-glide`, `--butler-ink-blue`, `--butler-ink-purple`, `--butler-ink-pink`, `--browser-overlay-shadow`

### BrowserPane

`import { BrowserPane } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/BrowserPane`

The browser sheet: tab row, toolbar and the page card, inset on a tinted pane whose top corners match the card.

- Use for: The browser beside a conversation (the AdaptiveShellSplit pane)
- Use for: The standalone Browser view under its title bar
- Not for: A preview of a Butler output inside the chat → `ArtifactPreview`
- Not for: A page frame inside a dashboard or settings → `SurfacePanel`
- Tokens: `--browser-pane-bg`, `--browser-pane-radius`, `--browser-card-inset`, `--browser-band-height`, `--menu-item-height`

### DragPreview

`import { DragPreview } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/DragPreview`

What follows the pointer while picks or a browser tab are dragged: stacked crops with a count, or the lifted tab, with an invalid badge.

- Use for: The drag image for picked elements (to the chat, a conversation, the library)
- Use for: A tab dragged from the pane to the sidebar
- Not for: Reordering rows inside the sidebar → `NavDropTarget`
- Not for: Reordering tabs inside the strip → `TabStrip`
- Tokens: `--shadow-drag-lift`, `--accent`, `--color-danger`, `--radius-control`

### PageBand

`import { PageBand } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/PageBand`

One 40px line on a PageCard's top edge for page-scoped state: who holds the tab, an approval, your input, picking, a pop-up.

- Use for: State that belongs to one page, with up to three actions on it
- Use for: Butler's control verbs: Take over, Give back to Butler, Stop task
- Not for: State of the whole app or a form → `Notice`
- Not for: A transient confirmation (scrapped, moved) → `Toast`
- Tokens: `--browser-band-height`, `--butler-ink-blue`, `--butler-ink-purple`, `--color-warning-bg`, `--color-info-bg`

### PageCard

`import { PageCard } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/PageCard`

The web page as one elevated card that wraps NativeViewSlot: who holds the tab, the band, the load line and Butler's letterboxed page.

- Use for: The page area of BrowserPane (one card per visible tab)
- Use for: Showing who holds a tab: nobody, Butler (riso edge), you, or an approval
- Not for: A native view without the browser card (a raw slot) → `NativeViewSlot`
- Not for: A static picture of a page in the chat → `ArtifactPreview`
- Tokens: `--radius-popover`, `--browser-card-shadow`, `--butler-ink-blue`, `--butler-ink-purple`, `--butler-ink-pink`, `--motion-agent-edge`, `--motion-loop-count`

### PopupWindowChrome

`import { PopupWindowChrome } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/PopupWindowChrome`

The whole document of a Butler-owned pop-up window: a compact 40px bar with the native controls, lock and host over the page.

- Use for: A pop-up a page opens on a click (sign-in, payment), kept with its opener
- Not for: The main window's title bar → `TitlebarShell`
- Not for: A page dialog (confirm, HTTP sign-in) → `Dialog`
- Tokens: `--browser-band-height`, `--popover`, `--radius-panel`, `--text-tertiary`

### SelectionBar

`import { SelectionBar } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/SelectionBar`

The picked-elements toolbar over the page: a count, what to do with the picks, and Clear, on one line at every width.

- Use for: One or more page elements are picked (PageCard overlay)
- Use for: The selection stays on the tab after picking ends (compact pill)
- Not for: Actions on one row of a list → `OverflowActionMenu`
- Not for: Page-wide state such as pick mode itself → `PageBand`
- Tokens: `--browser-band-height`, `--popover`, `--shadow-window`, `--accent`, `--radius-pill`

## Blocks · Navigation

### CollapsibleNavGroup

`import { CollapsibleNavGroup } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/CollapsibleNavGroup`

A navigation folder: a header row that expands and folds its child rows with the DS reveal motion.

- Use for: A project or folder in the sidebar tree
- Use for: Collapsible categories in a navigation list
- Not for: A heading that never collapses → `NavSection`
- Not for: Expanding details in content → `DisclosureRow`
- Tokens: `--sidebar-row-height`, `--motion-base`, `--motion-exit-base`

### CommandPanel

`import { CommandPanel } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/CommandPanel`

Command search: CommandPalettePanel is the Cmd+K dialog; CommandPanel is the inline search surface.

- Use for: Global search and commands on Cmd+K (CommandPalettePanel)
- Use for: An embedded search-and-results panel (CommandPanel)
- Not for: Choosing a value for one field → `FilteredSelectPopover`
- Not for: Filtering a single list in place → `Input`
- Tokens: `--command-overlay-bg`, `--motion-palette`, `--motion-scale-palette`, `--radius-popover`

### FilteredSelectPopover

`import { FilteredSelectPopover } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/FilteredSelectPopover`

A search-first chooser with filters, grouped results and an optional footer choice (inside a Popover).

- Use for: Pick a model from many providers
- Use for: Any select whose list needs search
- Not for: Under ten plain options → `Select`
- Not for: A global command search → `CommandPalettePanel`
- Tokens: `--menu-item-height`, `--radius-popover`, `--scroll-fade-size`

### ListRow

`import { ListRow } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/ListRow`

A presentational row: icon, title, optional description and trailing meta with two-region truncation.

- Use for: Rows of data in panels and lists (automations, artifacts, models)
- Not for: Navigation rows → `NavRow`
- Not for: Label/value facts → `KeyValueRow`
- Not for: A document with open/save actions → `DocumentTile`
- Tokens: `--space-sm`, `--text-secondary`, `--icon-size-md`

### NavDropTarget

`import { NavDropTarget } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/NavDropTarget`

Drop feedback for navigation trees: an insert slot, a group ring and a root zone, driven by stable drop zones.

- Use for: Reorder or group rows by dragging in the sidebar
- Not for: Reordering cards in a settings list → `SortableCardList`
- Not for: A static list → `NavSection`
- Tokens: `--z-drop-indicator`, `--z-drop-hint`, `--drop-clip-margin`, `--motion-base`, `--accent`

### NavRow

`import { NavRow } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/NavRow`

The navigation row: icon and label on the left, badge or actions on the right, flat active state.

- Use for: Rows in the sidebar, settings navigation and other navigation lists
- Use for: A row with hover-revealed actions
- Not for: A data row that is not navigation → `ListRow`
- Not for: A folder that expands → `CollapsibleNavGroup`
- Not for: A generic clickable surface → `Clickable`
- Tokens: `--sidebar-row-height`, `--selection-strong`, `--selection`, `--sidebar-action-size`, `--motion-fast`

### NavSection

`import { NavSection } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/NavSection`

A titled group of navigation rows with optional heading actions.

- Use for: Group rows under a heading in the sidebar or settings navigation
- Not for: A titled region of page content → `Section`
- Not for: A folder that expands and collapses → `CollapsibleNavGroup`
- Tokens: `--typo-section-title-size`, `--text-tertiary`, `--space-sm`

### OptionMenu

`import { OptionMenu } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/OptionMenu`

A compact chooser surface (inside a Popover) with flat sections, icons, descriptions and a selected mark.

- Use for: Choose a mode or permission from the composer
- Use for: A small menu that mixes actions and a current choice
- Not for: Actions for an item → `DropdownMenu`
- Not for: Search across many options → `FilteredSelectPopover`
- Tokens: `--menu-item-height`, `--menu-group-label-size`, `--access-full`, `--access-ask`, `--access-read-icon`

### OverflowActionMenu

`import { OverflowActionMenu } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/OverflowActionMenu`

The More (…) button and menu for a row's actions, from a simple items array.

- Use for: Rename, archive, delete and similar actions on a row or header
- Not for: Grouped menus, submenus or radio items → `DropdownMenu`
- Not for: One or two always-visible actions → `ButtonContainer`
- Tokens: `--menu-item-height`, `--radius-popover`, `--color-danger`

### TabStrip

`import { TabStrip } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/TabStrip`

The Browser area's tab row: closable, reorderable tabs grouped as my tabs plus one muted, foldable group per conversation.

- Use for: Browser tabs over a page area (pair with NativeViewSlot)
- Use for: Tabs the user and conversations open, grouped by owner
- Not for: Switching peer views inside one panel → `Tabs`
- Not for: Sidebar navigation between conversations → `NavRow`
- Not for: Reordering settings cards → `SortableCardList`
- Tokens: `--tab-strip-tab-min-width`, `--tab-strip-tab-max-width`, `--tab-strip-chip-max-width`, `--selection-strong`, `--control-height-md`, `--scroll-fade-size`, `--motion-base`, `--color-warning-text`, `--color-danger-text`

## Blocks · Composer

### AttachmentList

`import { AttachmentList } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/AttachmentList`

Files attached to a message: a list with sizes and links, or removable chips in the composer.

- Use for: Files the user attached (composer chips) or sent (message list)
- Not for: Files Butler produced → `ArtifactList`
- Not for: Project documents → `DocumentTile`
- Tokens: `--radius-pill`, `--line`, `--icon-size-sm`

### ComposerAdjunctPanel

`import { ComposerAdjunctPanel } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/ComposerAdjunctPanel`

The collapsible shell attached above the composer (the adjunct slot) with a one-line collapsed summary.

- Use for: Build a new composer-attached panel type
- Not for: Plan steps → `TodoProgressPanel`
- Not for: Worker activity → `WorkerActivityPanel`
- Not for: A warning about the composer → `Notice`
- Tokens: `--composer-glass-bg`, `--radius-composer`, `--motion-base`

### ComposerCard

`import { ComposerCard } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/ComposerCard`

The glass message composer: editor, toolbar, send/stop button, notices and attached adjunct panels.

- Use for: Writing a message to Butler (new chat or follow-up)
- Not for: A multi-line form field → `Textarea`
- Not for: A search box → `Input`
- Tokens: `--composer-glass-bg`, `--composer-glass-filter`, `--radius-composer`, `--send-bg`, `--send-fg`

### ComposerControl

`import { ComposerControl } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/ComposerControl`

The composer toolbar control: icon, label and optional detail on a pill, or a Select trigger (ComposerSelectControl).

- Use for: A composer setting that opens a menu (access, model, workspace)
- Not for: A plain chip action → `PillButton`
- Not for: A form select outside the composer → `Select`
- Tokens: `--control-height-sm`, `--radius-pill`, `--composer-glass-control-bg`, `--danger`

### ComposerDecisionPanel

`import { ComposerDecisionPanel } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/ComposerDecisionPanel`

The composer's decision state: what is being decided, optional detail lines, an optional failure, and the decision buttons in the composer radius.

- Use for: A plan waiting for acceptance or an authority request that replaces the composer input
- Not for: A notice inside the conversation → `Notice`
- Not for: A modal confirmation → `Dialog`
- Tokens: `--adaptive-composer-radius`, `--space-xs`, `--space-sm`, `--space-md`, `--space-lg`, `--icon-size-sm`, `--text-secondary`

### ComposerQuestionPanel

`import { ComposerQuestionPanel } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/ComposerQuestionPanel`

A bounded question form replacing the composer editor and toolbar, with local choices and a review step.

- Use for: One to four single, multi or text questions awaiting a user answer
- Not for: A permission decision → `ComposerDecisionPanel`
- Tokens: `--control-hit-target`, `--space-sm`, `--icon-size-lg`, `--selection`

### ContextDonutButton

`import { ContextDonutButton } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/ContextDonutButton`

A small donut button that shows how full the context window is and opens its details.

- Use for: Context usage in the composer toolbar
- Not for: A labelled progress bar in a panel → `ProgressMeter`
- Not for: A breakdown of usage by category → `KeyValueRow`
- Not for: A progress ring that is not a button → `ProgressRing`
- Tokens: `--context-chart-1`, `--context-track-bg`, `--control-height-sm`

### ElementChip

`import { ElementChip } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/ElementChip`

A picked page element as an attachment chip: its crop, a short title and the site; removable in the composer, read-only in messages.

- Use for: Elements picked in the browser and added to the chat
- Use for: The same chips inside the sent message
- Not for: Files and images from disk → `AttachmentList`
- Not for: A reference to a conversation or document in text → `InlineReference`
- Tokens: `--control-height-sm`, `--radius-control`, `--composer-glass-control-bg`, `--text-tertiary`

### PromptSuggestionList

`import { PromptSuggestionList } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/PromptSuggestionList`

The new-chat starter: a headline, prompt suggestions that fill the composer, and the optional wallpaper behind them.

- Use for: An empty conversation that should offer next steps
- Not for: Nothing to suggest → `EmptyLine`
- Not for: A decorative translucent surface → `TintedGlass`
- Tokens: `--typo-new-chat-title-size`, `--typo-new-chat-title-size-md`, `--radius-panel`, `--motion-base`

### SplitButton

`import { SplitButton } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/SplitButton`

A primary action joined to a menu of related variants of the same action.

- Not for: Unrelated actions → `DropdownMenu`
- Not for: One action → `Button`

### StatusCapsule

`import { StatusCapsule } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/StatusCapsule`

A glass pill that summarizes running work: title · detail · progress, each part truncating within its cap.

- Not for: A plain filter chip → `PillButton`
- Tokens: `--status-capsule-title-max`, `--status-capsule-detail-max`, `--composer-glass-bg`

### ActivityFeed

A titled list of activity items whose icons align with the first title line.

### WorkActivityBlock

### WorkerActivityPanel
