## Blocks · Feedback

### Notice

`import { Notice } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/Notice`

An inline status message (neutral, info, success, warning, error) with an optional title and action.

- Use for: A failure or warning tied to one part of the screen
- Use for: A persistent status the user should notice
- Not for: A transient confirmation → `Toaster`
- Not for: An empty list → `EmptyLine`
- Not for: A field error → `FieldError`
- Tokens: `--muted`, `--color-danger-bg`, `--color-warning-bg`, `--color-info-bg`, `--color-success-bg`, `--radius-control`, `--icon-size-md`, `--typo-body-line-height`

## Blocks · Inspector

### InspectorPanel

`import { InspectorPanel } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/InspectorPanel`

A titled group inside an inspector tab with the inspector's inset and tight list rhythm.

- Use for: Group facts or lists inside the right-panel inspector
- Not for: A titled region elsewhere → `Section`
- Not for: The tabbed inspector frame → `InspectorShell`
- Tokens: `--typo-panel-section-title-size`, `--space-sm`, `--space-xs`

### InspectorShell

`import { InspectorShell } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/InspectorShell`

The right-panel inspector: icon tabs, a flat selected tab and a scrolling body; InspectorInset aligns custom content.

- Use for: The inspector beside the conversation
- Not for: Tabs inside page content → `Tabs`
- Not for: One group in the inspector → `InspectorPanel`
- Tokens: `--right-panel-width`, `--selection`, `--space-md`

### KeyValueRow

`import { KeyValueRow } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/KeyValueRow`

A label/value fact row with optional description, meta and a swatch bound to the label line.

- Use for: Facts in the inspector, developer logs and document readers
- Use for: A chart legend row with a value
- Not for: Two to five facts on one line → `MetaList`
- Not for: A row with a title and trailing meta that is not a fact → `ListRow`
- Tokens: `--context-chart-1`, `--context-chart-2`, `--text-secondary`, `--space-xs`

### ProgressMeter

`import { ProgressMeter } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/ProgressMeter`

A determinate progress bar (0–100) with a label row, tones and a bare track variant; indeterminate shows a spinner caption for an unknown total.

- Use for: Show a known fraction: budget used, steps done
- Use for: A labelled transfer whose total is not known yet (indeterminate)
- Not for: Unknown duration with no label (a busy button or row) → `Spinner`
- Not for: Context usage in the composer toolbar → `ContextDonutButton`
- Not for: Progress in an icon slot (sidebar row, status line) → `ProgressRing`
- Tokens: `--accent`, `--color-success`, `--selection`, `--motion-deliberate`, `--typo-caption-size`, `--typo-caption-line-height`

### TaskGraphCanvas

`import { TaskGraphCanvas } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/TaskGraphCanvas`

A read-only task DAG: ranked columns left to right on desktop and lanes top to bottom on phones, with prerequisite edges.

- Use for: The Tasks tab: one plan's tasks and their prerequisites
- Use for: Any read-only dependency view of a few to a few hundred tasks
- Not for: A flat list of steps for one turn → `TodoProgressPanel`
- Not for: Items grouped by status → `KanbanBoard`
- Not for: Reordering by drag → `SortableCardList`
- Tokens: `--line-strong`, `--danger`, `--worker-active`, `--space-4xl`, `--space-md`, `--scroll-fade-size`

### TaskGraphCard

`import { TaskGraphCard } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/TaskGraphCard`

One task in a task graph: status glyph, title, assignee and model, status tag with time, and the live step while running.

- Use for: Every node of TaskGraphCanvas or TaskGraphLanes
- Not for: A generic clickable item in a grid → `Card`
- Not for: A plan step in a turn → `TodoProgressPanel`
- Tokens: `--worker-active`, `--pulse-duration`, `--motion-loop-count`, `--selection`, `--focus-ring`

### TaskGraphDetail

`import { TaskGraphDetail } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/TaskGraphDetail`

The selected task under its graph: status, facts, prerequisite links, the task document tile and the conversation action.

- Use for: Under the TaskGraphSection that owns the selected task
- Not for: Generic inspector facts → `InspectorPanel`
- Not for: Reading the document itself → `DocumentReader`
- Tokens: `--surface-raised`, `--radius-panel`, `--space-md`

### TaskGraphLanes

`import { TaskGraphLanes } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/TaskGraphLanes`

The phone layout of a task graph: full-width cards top to bottom with a lane gutter for fan-out and join.

- Use for: Compact widths; TaskGraphCanvas renders it for you with orientation="auto"
- Not for: Desktop and tablet widths → `TaskGraphCanvas`
- Not for: A plain list of steps → `ActivityFeed`
- Tokens: `--line-strong`, `--worker-active`, `--danger`, `--color-warning`, `--space-sm`

### TaskGraphSection

`import { TaskGraphSection } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/TaskGraphSection`

The Tasks tab body: TaskGraphPanel (header, summary, empty state) and one collapsible TaskGraphSection per plan graph.

- Use for: A conversation with one or more task graphs at once (one per plan)
- Not for: Any other expandable row → `DisclosureRow`
- Not for: A titled group of facts → `InspectorPanel`
- Tokens: `--selection`, `--space-xs`, `--space-sm`, `--space-lg`

### UsageSummaryRows

`import { UsageSummaryRows } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/UsageSummaryRows`

Provider usage in a popover or panel: quota windows as meters, token counts and a USD cost as rows, with loading, unavailable and stale states.

- Use for: Show subscription quota left (5-hour, weekly) with the reset time
- Use for: Show a conversation's tokens and cost for an API-key model
- Not for: Context window fill in the composer toolbar → `ContextDonutButton`
- Not for: A single known fraction with a label → `ProgressMeter`
- Not for: Dashboard totals with trends → `MetricGrid`
- Tokens: `--text-tertiary`, `--space-md`, `--space-xs`, `--motion-deliberate`

## Blocks · Settings & Forms

### CardList

`import { CardList } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/CardList`

A bordered list of item cards (skills, MCP servers) with a title, empty state and a scroll cap.

- Use for: A settings list of configured things with per-item actions
- Not for: Reordering by drag → `SortableCardList`
- Not for: Rows inside a panel → `ListRow`
- Tokens: `--line`, `--radius-panel`, `--selection`, `--space-sm`

### ChoiceCard

`import { ChoiceCard } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/ChoiceCard`

Big, recognizable choices: a row card or a grid tile with a logo, a name, a short description and its state.

- Use for: Picking one service, model or option where logos and names help recognition
- Use for: A long tail of choices in an equal-size grid
- Not for: Choosing a value inside a form → `Select`
- Not for: Two to four short text options → `SegmentedControl`
- Not for: A card that shows content, not a choice → `Card`
- Tokens: `--control-bg`, `--control-hover-bg`, `--line`, `--line-strong`, `--accent`, `--color-info-bg`, `--danger-line-strong`, `--radius-panel`, `--focus-ring`

### DialogForm

`import { DialogForm } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/DialogForm`

The body of a dialog task: title, description, fields and a footer, submitted as a form.

- Use for: Create, rename or configure something inside a Dialog
- Not for: A settings page → `FormSection`
- Not for: A one-question confirmation → `DialogHeader`
- Tokens: `--space-lg`, `--settings-field-gap`, `--typo-panel-title-size`

### FormSection

`import { FormSection } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/FormSection`

A settings section: header (title, description) above its card, fields inside following the settings ramp.

- Use for: Group related settings on a settings page
- Not for: A titled region in a panel → `Section`
- Not for: One row with an action → `SurfacePanel`
- Tokens: `--settings-section-header-gap`, `--settings-section-padding`, `--settings-field-gap`, `--settings-section-gap`

### PercentInputControl

`import { PercentInputControl } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/PercentInputControl`

A percentage setting: a number input and a slider that commit together, with a percent readout.

- Use for: A percentage setting that needs both a feel and an exact value
- Not for: A plain range without exact entry → `Slider`
- Not for: A token budget → `TokenInputControl`
- Tokens: `--accent`, `--control-height-md`, `--space-sm`

### SettingsField

`import { SettingsField } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/SettingsField`

One setting: label, description, control and optional meta on the settings spacing ramp.

- Use for: Every setting inside a FormSection or a dialog form
- Not for: A field in an editor form (MCP server, persona) → `Field`
- Not for: A group of secret key/value rows → `SettingsSecretRows`
- Tokens: `--settings-field-copy-gap`, `--settings-field-control-gap`, `--settings-field-gap`

### SettingsHeader

`import { SettingsHeader } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/SettingsHeader`

The settings detail header: page title, description, a secondary line and one action slot.

- Use for: The top of a settings detail page
- Not for: A dashboard or management page title → `DashboardHeader`
- Not for: A section inside the page → `FormSection`
- Tokens: `--typo-app-title-size`, `--text-secondary`, `--space-sm`

### SettingsNav

`import { SettingsNav } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/SettingsNav`

A titled group of settings sections as navigation rows, from an items array.

- Use for: The settings sidebar, one SettingsNav per group
- Not for: The app sidebar → `SidebarShell`
- Not for: Rows with custom content → `NavRow`
- Tokens: `--sidebar-row-height`, `--selection-strong`, `--typo-section-title-size`

### SettingsSecretRows

`import { SettingsSecretRows } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/SettingsSecretRows`

Editable key/value secret rows with a value source per row and a shared toolbar.

- Use for: MCP headers and environment variables whose values may come from env or the keychain
- Not for: Read-only facts → `KeyValueRow`
- Not for: A single secret → `SettingsField`
- Tokens: `--space-sm`, `--control-height-md`, `--line`

### SettingsSection

`import { SettingsSection } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/SettingsSection`

The structure of a settings page: SettingsPage holds only SettingsSections, each one header above one card that owns its loading, error and empty states.

- Use for: Every settings page and settings subpage
- Use for: A settings list that loads, can fail or can be empty (kind list or status)
- Use for: Read-only app information (kind info with KeyValueRow)
- Not for: A titled form outside the settings window → `FormSection`
- Not for: A form inside a dialog → `DialogForm`
- Not for: A standalone panel with its own action → `SurfacePanel`
- Tokens: `--settings-section-gap`, `--settings-section-header-gap`, `--settings-section-padding`, `--settings-panel-bg`, `--settings-bg`, `--line`

### SettingsShell

`import { SettingsShell } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/SettingsShell`

The settings layout: navigation master, detail header and detail pane, single-pane on compact widths.

- Use for: The settings screen and settings-like editors
- Not for: A management page (automations, dashboards) → `ManagementPage`
- Not for: A setup flow → `SetupWizardShell`
- Tokens: `--settings-bg`, `--settings-section-gap`, `--settings-section-header-gap`, `--page-max-width-reading`

### SortableCardList

`import { SortableCardList } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/SortableCardList`

A reorderable card list (pointer and keyboard) with lift and neighbor-slide motion.

- Use for: The order of items matters and people set it (backup models)
- Not for: Order does not matter → `CardList`
- Not for: Reordering sidebar rows → `NavDropTarget`
- Tokens: `--motion-scale-lift`, `--shadow-drag-lift`, `--motion-base`, `--motion-ease-standard`

### TokenInputControl

`import { TokenInputControl } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/TokenInputControl`

A token budget setting: a number input and a slider over the model's range, with a value / max readout.

- Use for: A token limit bounded by the active model
- Not for: A percentage → `PercentInputControl`
- Not for: A free number → `Input`
- Tokens: `--accent`, `--control-height-md`, `--space-sm`

### WallpaperPicker

`import { WallpaperPicker } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/WallpaperPicker`

Chooses a wallpaper: still thumbnails of none, every live module (the user's own last) and the uploaded images, an import-module and an upload tile, and the selected choice's controls generated from its manifest (images: fit, dim, blur, filter).

- Use for: The Home screen wallpaper setting
- Use for: A project's wallpaper, with an inherit tile that follows the global one
- Use for: Any place a WallpaperSource is chosen by the user
- Not for: Drawing the chosen wallpaper → `Wallpaper`
- Not for: Choosing between a few text options → `SegmentedControl`
- Tokens: `--radius-control`, `--focus-ring`, `--text-primary`, `--selection`, `--motion-fast`

## Blocks · Dashboard & Metrics

### ActivityHeatmap

`import { ActivityHeatmap } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/ActivityHeatmap`

A calendar of days shaded by activity count, optionally selectable with a legend.

- Use for: Show activity over weeks on a project dashboard
- Not for: Exact values per series → `ChartContainer`
- Not for: One total → `MetricCard`
- Tokens: `--accent`, `--selection`, `--radius-control`

### ActivityStrip

`import { ActivityStrip } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/ActivityStrip`

A thin strip with one cell per day, filled on the days something changed.

- Use for: Show when a document or source changed over a short window, under a list row
- Not for: Weeks of activity in a calendar grid → `ActivityHeatmap`
- Not for: A share of a total → `ProgressMeter`
- Tokens: `--line`, `--context-chart-1`, `--space-sm`

### AutomationRunList

`import { AutomationRunList } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/AutomationRunList`

The run history of an automation, newest first, with state icons aligned to titles.

- Use for: Show recent runs on an automation detail page
- Not for: General activity → `ActivityFeed`
- Not for: The automation itself → `ListRow`
- Tokens: `--color-success`, `--color-danger`, `--icon-size-md`

### DashboardHeader

`import { DashboardHeader } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/DashboardHeader`

The header of a dashboard or management page: dashboard title, description, meta and the primary action.

- Use for: Top of the project dashboard or the automations page
- Not for: A settings page → `SettingsHeader`
- Not for: A side panel → `PanelHeader`
- Tokens: `--typo-dashboard-title-size`, `--typo-dashboard-title-weight`, `--space-md`

### EventTimeline

`import { EventTimeline } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/EventTimeline`

Dated events in order, each with a kind marker joined to the next event by a hairline connector.

- Use for: Project history: records created, updated, completed or reported, grouped by day
- Not for: Progress or recent activity in the inspector → `ActivityFeed`
- Not for: Automation run history → `AutomationRunList`
- Tokens: `--space-2xl`, `--space-md`, `--border-hairline`, `--line`, `--text-tertiary`

### MetricCard

`import { MetricCard } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/MetricCard`

One labelled number, counting to new values, with an optional trend and icon.

- Use for: Key numbers on a dashboard or usage page
- Not for: A trend over time → `ChartContainer`
- Not for: A fraction of a budget → `ProgressMeter`
- Tokens: `--typo-metric-value-size`, `--typo-metric-value-weight`, `--surface-raised`, `--radius-panel`

### MetricGrid

`import { MetricGrid } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/MetricGrid`

A responsive grid for MetricCards (150px+ columns by default, or a column preset).

- Use for: A row of metrics on a dashboard
- Not for: Cards that are not metrics → `Grid`
- Not for: One metric → `MetricCard`
- Tokens: `--space-md`, `--layout-basis-xs`

## Blocks · Documents & Artifacts

### ArtifactList

`import { ArtifactList } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/ArtifactList`

Files Butler produced in an answer: open the artifact, save it, or run another action.

- Use for: Artifacts attached to an assistant message
- Not for: Files the user attached → `AttachmentList`
- Not for: Artifacts in the inspector → `DocumentTile`
- Tokens: `--surface-raised`, `--radius-panel`, `--icon-size-lg`

### ArtifactPreview

`import { ArtifactPreview } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/ArtifactPreview`

The artifact viewer body: exactly one of text, image or frame (PDF/HTML), or a loading/failed caption.

- Use for: Preview an artifact in the artifact viewer or a document dialog
- Not for: Rendered markdown documents → `MarkdownContent`
- Not for: Reading a spec with facts → `DocumentReader`
- Tokens: `--surface`, `--radius-panel`, `--typo-code-size`

### DocumentReader

`import { DocumentReader } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/DocumentReader`

A read-only document view: header, fact list, hint, action, details and the document body.

- Use for: Read a project document or spec in a dialog
- Not for: Only rendered markdown → `MarkdownContent`
- Not for: An artifact file preview → `ArtifactPreview`
- Tokens: `--page-max-width-reading`, `--text-secondary`, `--space-lg`

### DocumentTile

`import { DocumentTile } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/DocumentTile`

A document or artifact tile: badge, title, meta and either a whole-tile open or an explicit Open action.

- Use for: Artifacts in the inspector
- Use for: Plans and specs on the project dashboard
- Not for: Artifacts under an answer → `ArtifactList`
- Not for: A resource in a grid → `CardList`
- Tokens: `--surface-raised`, `--radius-panel`, `--line`, `--selection`

### KanbanBoard

`import { KanbanBoard } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/KanbanBoard`

Lanes of documents side by side; each lane scrolls at a fixed height under its title.

- Use for: Plans or tasks grouped by status
- Not for: One list of documents → `CardList`
- Not for: Categories with a detail list → `SplitBrowser`
- Tokens: `--kanban-lane-height`, `--kanban-lane-min-width`, `--space-md`, `--line`

### LibraryCard

`import { LibraryCard } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/LibraryCard`

One library (서랍) item on a Card with a media slot: an image, quote or document preview, a kind tag, title, source and a ⋯ menu.

- Use for: The library page and the new-tab page's recent scraps
- Use for: Any grid of saved page pieces (elements, views, outputs)
- Not for: A file or output in the inspector → `ArtifactList`
- Not for: A document with status and dates → `DocumentTile`
- Tokens: `--radius-control`, `--muted`, `--line-height-body`, `--text-tertiary`

### MarkdownContent

`import { MarkdownContent } from "@/butler-ds";` · stable · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/MarkdownContent`

Document typography for rendered markdown: headings, lists, code frames, tables, quotes and the streaming fade.

- Use for: Assistant answers, READMEs and project documents rendered from markdown
- Not for: UI text → `Typo`
- Not for: Raw file contents → `ArtifactPreviewPre`
- Tokens: `--line-height-document`, `--typo-code-size`, `--syntax-keyword`, `--radius-panel`, `--accent-text`, `--favicon-plate`

### SplitBrowser

`import { SplitBrowser } from "@/butler-ds";` · beta · viewer: `?visual=design-system&page=blocks/SplitBrowser`

Categories on the start side and the selected category's items on the end side, in one surface.

- Use for: Browse documents grouped by category (specs by area)
- Not for: Items grouped by status → `KanbanBoard`
- Not for: Settings pages → `SettingsShell`
- Tokens: `--split-browser-height`, `--space-md`, `--line`

## Build a screen

Real Butler screens assembled only from DS pieces (no CSS files, no className, no inline styles).

### Settings page

A narrow, start-aligned page: page header, then sections whose headers sit above their cards; fields follow the settings ramp. Uses: `PageContainer`, `SettingsHeader`, `FormSection`, `SettingsField`, `Select`, `Switch`, `Input`.

```tsx
export function SettingsPageRecipe() {
  return (
    <PageContainer width="narrow" align="start">
      <Stack gap="2xl">
        <SettingsHeader title="General" description="Language, appearance and notifications." />
        <SettingsPage>
          <SettingsSection id="appearance" kind="form" title="Appearance" description="Applies to every window.">
            <SettingsField id="theme" label="Theme" control={(
              <Select defaultValue="system">
                <SelectTrigger id="theme"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="system">System</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="light">Light</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="dark">Dark</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            )} />
            <SettingsField id="translucent" label="Translucent sidebar" description="Show the desktop behind the sidebar."
              control={<Switch id="translucent" defaultChecked />} />
          </SettingsSection>
          <SettingsSection id="profile" kind="form" title="Profile">
            <SettingsField id="name" label="Display name" control={<Input id="name" defaultValue="Butler" />} />
          </SettingsSection>
        </SettingsPage>
      </Stack>
    </PageContainer>
  );
}
```

### Conversation turn

A user bubble, the assistant's work activity and answer with its footer, and the follow-up composer. Uses: `MessageRow`, `WorkActivityBlock`, `MarkdownContent`, `MessageFooter`, `CopyButton`, `ComposerCard`, `IconButton`.

```tsx
export function ConversationTurnRecipe() {
  return (
    <Stack gap="lg">
      <MessageRow role="user">Summarize what changed in the settings pages.</MessageRow>
      <MessageRow role="assistant">
        <WorkActivityBlock title="Reading the settings pages" connected tools={[
          { id: "search", icon: <Search size="md" />, title: "Search: SettingsSection", summaryLabel: "Search" },
          { id: "bash", icon: <Terminal size="md" />, title: "Bash: bun run app:layout:smoke", summaryLabel: "Bash" },
        ]} />
        <MarkdownContent>
          <p>Section headers now sit above their cards, and every field follows one spacing ramp.</p>
        </MarkdownContent>
        <MessageFooter>
          <CopyButton text="Section headers now sit above their cards." label="Copy message" copiedLabel="Copied" />
        </MessageFooter>
      </MessageRow>
      <ComposerCard onSubmit={(event) => event.preventDefault()}>
        <ComposerCardTextarea aria-label="Message" placeholder="Ask for follow-up changes" rows={1} />
        <ComposerCardToolbar>
          <IconButton label="More options"><Plus size="md" /></IconButton>
          <ComposerCardToolbarSpacer />
          <ComposerSendButton aria-label="Send" />
        </ComposerCardToolbar>
      </ComposerCard>
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

### Sidebar

Sections of rows; project folders collapse; row actions appear on hover through an overflow menu. Uses: `NavSection`, `NavRow`, `CollapsibleNavGroup`, `OverflowActionMenu`, `IconButton`.

```tsx
export function SidebarRecipe() {
  return (
    <Stack gap="lg">
      <NavSection title="Chats">
        <NavRow icon={<GeneralChat size="md" />} label="General" active onClick={() => undefined} />
      </NavSection>
      <NavSection title="Projects" actions={<IconButton label="New project"><Plus size="md" /></IconButton>}>
        <CollapsibleNavGroup expanded icon={<FolderOpen size="md" />} label="butler" onToggle={() => undefined}>
          <NavRow label="Token page review" onClick={() => undefined} actionsVisibility="hover" actions={(
            <OverflowActionMenu label="Session actions" items={[
              { icon: <PencilLine size="sm" />, label: "Rename", onSelect: () => undefined },
              { icon: <Archive size="sm" />, label: "Archive", onSelect: () => undefined },
            ]} />
          )} />
          <NavRow label="Settings S7" onClick={() => undefined} />
        </CollapsibleNavGroup>
        <CollapsibleNavGroup expanded={false} icon={<Folder size="md" />} label="butler-site" onToggle={() => undefined}>
          <NavRow label="Landing copy" />
        </CollapsibleNavGroup>
      </NavSection>
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

### Project dashboard

Header with the primary action, counting metrics, the activity calendar and document tiles. Uses: `DashboardHeader`, `MetricGrid`, `MetricCard`, `ActivityHeatmap`, `DocumentTile`, `Button`.

```tsx
export function DashboardRecipe() {
  return (
    <Stack gap="2xl">
      <DashboardHeader title="butler" action={(
        <Button variant="outline"><MessageSquarePlus size="md" /> New chat</Button>
      )} />
      <MetricGrid>
        <MetricCard label="Open work" value={12} />
        <MetricCard label="Done this week" value={31} trend="up" change="+8" />
        <MetricCard label="Conversations" value={46} />
      </MetricGrid>
      <ActivityHeatmap ariaLabel="Recent activity" startWeekday={1} days={Array.from({ length: 28 }, (_, index) => (
        { id: `day-${index}`, label: `Day ${index + 1}`, count: (index * 5) % 9 }
      ))} />
      <Stack gap="xs">
        <DocumentTile badge="Plan" icon={<FileText size="md" />} title="Settings hierarchy rollout" meta="In review" actionLabel="Open" onOpen={() => undefined} />
        <DocumentTile icon={<FileText size="md" />} title="Design-system spec" meta="specs/design-system.md" actionLabel="Open" onOpen={() => undefined} />
      </Stack>
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

### Dialog form

A focused task: title, description, fields and a right-aligned footer. Put it inside DialogContent. Uses: `DialogForm`, `SettingsField`, `Input`, `ButtonContainer`, `Button`.

```tsx
export function DialogFormRecipe() {
  return (
    <DialogForm title="New project" description="Name the project and pick its folder." onSubmit={() => undefined}
      footer={(
        <ButtonContainer size="default" justify="end">
          <Button type="button" variant="outline">Cancel</Button>
          <Button type="submit">Create</Button>
        </ButtonContainer>
      )}>
      <SettingsField id="project-name" label="Project name" control={<Input id="project-name" defaultValue="butler-site" />} />
    </DialogForm>
  );
}
```

### Empty, loading and error states

Say what is missing and offer the next step; show the shape while loading; errors explain and retry. Uses: `EmptyLine`, `Skeleton`, `Notice`, `Button`.

```tsx
export function StatesRecipe() {
  return (
    <Stack gap="xl">
      <EmptyLine message="No automations yet." action={<Button size="sm" variant="outline" iconStart={<Plus size="md" />} text="New automation" />} />
      <Stack gap="sm" aria-busy="true">
        <Skeleton label="Loading settings" height="title" width="2/5" />
        <Skeleton height="row" width="full" />
      </Stack>
      <Notice tone="error" title="Could not load the dashboard" message="Check the connection and try again."
        action={<Button variant="outline" text="Retry" />} />
    </Stack>
  );
}
```
